meta_evidence.doc_number: DIRECTIVE (EU) 2019/790 OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL
meta_evidence.entry_into_force: This Directive shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
meta_evidence.transposition: 1. Member States shall bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 7 June 2021.
meta_evidence.issuer: THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

record.title: Directive (EU) 2019/790 of the European Parliament and of the Council
record.issuer: European Parliament、Council of the European Union
record.status_note: 32 条全文取自《欧盟官方公报》OJ L 130（2019-05-17）。第 31 条规定公布后第 20 日生效（推算为 2019-06-06）；指令本身须经成员国转化为国内法（第 29 条规定转化期限为 2021-06-07），不直接对私人适用。第 3、4 条是欧盟文本与数据挖掘（TDM）例外的核心法源，且第 4 条第 3 款的权利保留被 EU AI Act 第 53 条第 1 款第 (c) 项直接援引
